title: Allow planned and text-only documentation sections

fields.outcome: Authors can plan and preview documentation before every chapter has been captured.
fields.scope: Allow planned sections that do not yet have a journey module, text-only sections without screenshots, and a draft renderer that shows clear placeholders for missing captures. Add explicit module requirements and test-data/fixture declarations where appropriate, while keeping capture validation distinct from draft rendering.
fields.acceptance: A valid draft spec can include planned chapters, prose-only sections, and screenshot placeholders before capture. Full capture validation still reports missing required modules or screenshots. A module can declare prerequisites and needed fixtures in a documented, validated shape.
fields.verification: Add spec validation cases for planned and text-only sections, generate a draft containing placeholders, confirm normal capture still enforces its required inputs, and validate module requirements and fixture declarations.
fields.risks: Draft permissiveness must not accidentally weaken production capture validation; distinguish draft and capture modes explicitly.
fields.source: Consumer feedback supplied by the user on 2026-11-03; scope and acceptance remain discovery-stage proposals.

criteria.expectation: A spec can include planned sections without a journey module and can render them in draft output.
A documentation section can contain text blocks without any screenshot blocks.
Draft rendering produces readable documentation and explicit placeholders for screenshots not yet captured.
Modules can declare prerequisite modules and required test data or fixtures, and validation checks those declarations.
